data.name: Holiday Inn Express Guadalajara Iteso by IHG
data.address: Ave Camino Al Iiteso :8650 Col, Paisajes del Tesoro, 45580 Guadalajara, Jal., Mexico
data.description:
Adjacent to the PIT2 industrial park, this modern budget hotel is 7 km from Expo Guadalajara convention center and 14 km from the Mercado San Juan de Dios.
Offering free Wi-Fi, the straightforward rooms also have flat-screen TVs, desks and coffeemakers. Suites add separate living areas.
A breakfast buffet and parking are complimentary. Other amenities include an exercise room and a business center.
